title: LPN: Graduate Nurses Accepted, Full Time, Per Diem, Weekends (all shifts):  7-3, 3-11, 11-7
description:
Are you a compassionate and dedicated Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) looking for a rewarding opportunity? Southport Center for Nursing and Rehabilitation is excited to welcome new team members to provide exceptional care to our residents.

Position Details:

  • Position Type: Full Time, Per Diem, Weekends (all shifts):  7-3, 3-11, 11-7
  • Experience: Preferred, but we are happy to train motivated individuals eager to learn and grow in their nursing career.

What You’ll Need:

  • A current and valid LPN license in good standing.
  • A passion for providing quality care and supporting residents’ well-being.
  • A positive attitude and willingness to be a team player.

Why Southport?

  • Be part of a supportive, dynamic team dedicated to making a difference in residents' lives.
  • Gain valuable experience and grow your nursing skills in a welcoming environment.
  • Flexible scheduling.
